beginner.confidence: Medium-high. Same-day NWS zone forecast (5:14 AM HST) and Canoes model/report agree on near-100% rain, isolated thunderstorms and onshore wind all day. No buoy or direct break observation; your on-site check still decides.
beginner.headline: Today (Thu Oct 8): not recommended for beginner lessons. Flood Watch for Oʻahu through this afternoon (NWS point forecast: until 6 PM), near-100% rain with isolated thunderstorms, and SE–S onshore wind 10–20 mph. A Flood Advisory covered Honolulu/Mānoa late last night (reported), so brown water at Waikīkī is very likely, advisory posted or not.
beginner.recommendation: Cancel or reschedule today's lessons. No time window rates better than AVOID this morning. Only reconsider if, on site, the water at Canoes is visibly clear, no thunder, rain has stopped and the wind is well below forecast; even then a single strong adult only, and recheck the NWS alert list first. Friday looks better on weather (partly sunny, 50% showers, SE wind up to 10 mph), but runoff from last night and today can linger about 48 hours; check water color Friday before committing.

watch.head: Brown water very likely at Waikīkī today
watch.body: A Flood Advisory covered Honolulu, Mānoa, Kailua and Kāneʻohe late Wednesday night, with radar rates up to 1.5 in/hr around Mānoa (news report; advisory has since expired). Mānoa runoff reaches the Ala Wai beside Waikīkī. DOH guidance: stay out of storm-runoff water; coastal water usually takes about 48 hours to flush. No Waikīkī advisory was verified, and that is not proof the water is clean.

water.statement: No Waikīkī or Canoes-specific water-quality advisory was verified during this refresh. After last night's heavy rain over Mānoa and Honolulu and more forecast today, expect brown or turbid water at Waikīkī whether or not an advisory is posted.

water.runoff: Brown, gray, cloudy or turbid water, or visible runoff: don't go in, advisory or not. DOH guidance: storm-runoff water can carry sewage and pathogens; coastal water usually needs about 48 hours to flush.
